portal.vendor_source: portal fingerprint (2026-09-29): classic DEF Atrium build - /Content/def/ assets, def.co.uk links, __RequestVerificationToken on the /Search/Results form, /Document/Download?module=PLA links.

committee_papers.note: Not fingerprinted: on 2026-09-29 a GET of /mgWebService.asmx/GetCommittees on this host returned HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare managed challenge ('Just a moment...', cf-mitigated: challenge), so the run stopped there. The host is the council's meetings site; open it in a browser to find the planning committee.

reference_format.note: YYYYNNNN: an eight-digit number, year then serial, no separators or type suffix.

quirks.summary: Search results link the detail page in path form (/Planning/Display/<REF>), not ?applicationNumber=<REF>.
quirks.detail: A grep for the query form finds nothing and the search reads as empty. This fits the 2026-09-16 survey record 'search worked but returned nothing'.
quirks.workaround: Match /Planning/Display/ in both forms, or go straight to /Planning/Display/<REF>.

quirks.summary: Every page redirects to /Disclaimer until the disclaimer is accepted.
quirks.detail: POST /Disclaimer/Accept?returnUrl=%2F (empty body) sets AcceptedDisclaimer, valid for about an hour. The cookie arrived with a correct expiry here.
quirks.workaround: Accept once at the start of the session and keep the cookie jar through every download.

browser_route.note: The detail page lists the documents; the disclaimer is shown first in a new browser session.

endpoints.search: POST https://planning.leicester.gov.uk/Search/Results with __RequestVerificationToken, SearchPlanning=True, SearchAppeals, SearchEnforcement, SearchTreePreservationOrders, SearchBuildingControl (True/False), Outstanding=false, ApplicationNumber=<REF>, Address=
endpoints.note: Accept the disclaimer first: POST /Disclaimer/Accept?returnUrl=%2F with an empty body sets an AcceptedDisclaimer cookie (about one hour) and redirects to the search page, which then carries the form token. The form has a fifth scope flag, SearchBuildingControl, beyond the four in the recipe. The detail page is keyed by the reference, so the search can be skipped.

pacing.note: Six requests to planning.leicester.gov.uk at 5 s spacing on 2026-09-29, no 429 or challenge.

robots.note: No robots.txt (IIS 404). The disclaimer carries a copyright notice limiting downloaded material to consultation and comparison use, and a personal-data notice; it does not prohibit automated access.

verification.note: Landing-page survey 2026-09-16: HTTP 200; redirected to https://planning.leicester.gov.uk/Disclaimer?returnUrl=%2FSearch%2FAdvanced%2F/; vendor confirmed by fingerprint (def-atrium)
Recipe A: search worked but returned nothing for 1-31 July 2026. Not a retrieval failure.

Vendor fingerprinted from markup as classic DEF Atrium. robots.txt fetched (none). PlanIt's applics records (one call) gave 20261433 (n_documents 7). Accepted the disclaimer, then POSTed /Search/Results with the page's token and ApplicationNumber=20261433: the results linked /Planning/Display/20261433 (path form). The detail page carried 7 unique /Document/Download links, matching PlanIt's 7. Downloaded the location plan with the same jar: application/pdf, %PDF-1.7, 310,697 bytes, 1 page with extractable text, no rate-limit, permission or unavailable notice. The survey's empty search is explained by the path-form links. Dropped quirk 'vendor-unverified' (vendor fingerprinted in this run). The committee host returned a Cloudflare challenge to one web-service request; not pursued.
